scope: READ_ONLY_SOURCE_AUDIT; no phone operation, no model request, no physical USB-disconnection test
conclusion: The selected phone-local request path has no required Mac/Pocket4 computation or USB/ADB transport. The retained legacy ADB relay needs only its local listener/process/descriptor to satisfy bootstrap readiness; its upstream15037 is contacted only if an ADB client connects. Therefore source inspection does not identify unplugging USB or losing Mac alone as a trigger that stops the selected path. Real detach/coldboot/native business qualification is still separate.

links.finding: Android LocalSocket to abstract trillionnium_owner_open (lines28,68–71); no TCP/ADB/host is needed by this client.

Exactly one socket.create_connection to configured127.0.0.1:18080; no fallback/reconnect/redispatch. The endpoint is now the actual phone GNU provider. Old Codex/host names in schema and error text are legacy labels, not evidence of remote execution.
Model binds phone127.0.0.1:18087; provider endpoint is local HTTP and private key file. Launcher env -i removes inherited proxy/server variables. No cloud model fallback is selected.

For executor.mode phone_local_sidecar, _wire_call emits shell.exec argv /usr/bin/python3 <pinned tool_client.py> execute. The inherited _serial_guard uses local Android getprop ro.serialno; it does not require adb -s. The actual action goes through abstract hepta_phone_local_v150 to Bionic sidecar.

start() binds only the local listener and publishes descriptor. serve() waits on stop_event. The only asyncio.open_connection(upstream15037) is inside accept(), after a local ADB client connects. It does not proactively probe or depend on a live remote server at startup.

links.source: same selected relay accept() lines313–404 and record_event() lines300–311
links.finding: Upstream EOF/connect failure becomes a per-connection transport_error with bounded cleanup; it does not by itself stop the relay. Event journal failure can stop the instance, which is a separate local storage/process dependency.

WaitForSupervisorReady checks exactly2children including local owner-open-adb-relay, PID/starttime identity, descriptor listen15038/upstream15037, and no redispatch. It does not require successful upstream connection. Lines994–999,1089–1124. Line1448 still sets legacy ADB_SERVER_SOCKET.

residual_couplings.item: Unused ADB relay is still critical to native supervisor
residual_couplings.impact: If that local relay process/log/descriptor fails, the legacy supervisor/bootstrap can fail even though phone-local tools do not need it. Do not kill it casually in the current frozen combination.
residual_couplings.specific_fix: New phone_local profile should remove the relay from rootlinux-supervisor children and bootstrap exactly-two-children/RelayDescriptorPath checks; replace with actual local provider/driver readiness descriptors.

residual_couplings.item: Legacy adb executable and env remain part of native rootfs/CLI
residual_couplings.impact: File/config coupling persists, not a Mac/USB requirement. Selected executor never routes there; adb_legacy remains an explicit source branch, not an automatic fallback.
residual_couplings.specific_fix: Remove ADB_SERVER_SOCKET from the phone_local environment; remove/disable adb tool route and corresponding mandatory required paths for that profile. Preserve current historical core reproduction record.

residual_couplings.item: Provider port18080 historically used ADB reverse
residual_couplings.impact: A re-enabled old transport watcher could try to reclaim this port on a later boot before the phone provider. Root has disabled/unloaded it and removed the owned reverse; actual local bind is the current owner.
residual_couplings.specific_fix: Formal profile should use a separately named local provider config/endpoint and no dependency on the host-relay mapping. Keep startup port ownership checks and reject conflicts; never fallback to a host.

residual_couplings.impact: role host_codex and error strings can misdescribe current local operation; long_lived_credentials_on_phone=false cannot be read as absence of the new persistent local authentication key.
residual_couplings.specific_fix: New profile role phone_local; external_cloud_credentials=false and distinct local_auth.persisted/scope/key-file reference; neutral local-relay diagnostics.

residual_couplings.item: New module lifetime is outside original native supervisor
residual_couplings.impact: Current stop watcher observes the same inhibit, but unexpected supervisor death/leader disappearance does not itself prove all descendants gone. Cold boot and actual stop/quiescence need observations.
residual_couplings.specific_fix: Future profile should own local provider/model/sidecar lifecycle in one measured supervisor or a narrow authenticated Android-side supervisor boundary, with persistent original receipts and no automatic effect replay.
